bio.text: Josh Lowenthal, a Democrat, represents the 69th Assembly District, which covers part of Los Angeles County, in the California State Assembly.
Lowenthal's official website says he was elected in November 2022, worked as an entrepreneur and business owner in tech and telecom startups, and grew up in Long Beach.
